description:
Make `jit issue create` report the findings creation returns, the same set in human and JSON output, and stop reading the repository after the mutation publishes.

## Background

- The `IssueCommands::Create` arm of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` builds its JSON response through `get_dependencies_enriched` and `list_gate_runs` after the commit, and its human path lists every issue and calls `evaluate_graph_rules`, which captures a whole validation image, to print graph warnings; `--force` and `--quiet` suppress them, `--orphan` drops `orphan-leaf`. JSON output carries no findings. Measured on this repository: human 629 ms against 76 ms with `--quiet` (`dev/active/9876a23a-one-validation-report/investigation.md`, capture part, C6).
- A new issue has no dependencies and no gate runs, so its enriched dependencies and gate runs are empty by construction.
- The JSON payload type is `IssueShowResponse` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`), registered for `issue create` in `crates/jit/src/schema.rs:538-545`; the MCP bridge generates its create tool from that schema. `ClaimResponse` (`output.rs:1331`) flattens an issue beside `warnings`.
- `--orphan` tests: `tests/cli_issue/quiet_mode_tests.rs`, `tests/cli_query_graph/label_hierarchy_e2e_test.rs`, `tests/cli_query_graph/graph_json_tests.rs`; create-warning tests: `tests/fast_rules/cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `issue create --json` returns an `IssueCreateResponse` that flattens the issue view and adds `findings`, registered in the schema for `issue create`; the human path prints one line per finding. Both show the same findings, after `--orphan` drops `orphan-leaf`; `--force` suppresses none; `--quiet` keeps printing only the id.
- [hard] REQ-02: After creation publishes, the arm makes no storage, executor or capture call: no issue list, no graph-rule evaluation, no dependency enrichment and no gate-run listing.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test creates an orphan leaf with `--json` and finds its `orphan-leaf` finding in `findings`, and with the human path finds the same finding; the JSON assertion fails on today's code, whose response has no `findings`.
- [hard] REQ-04: The create-warning tests read the CLI output or the returned findings, and the `--orphan` tests pass.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: JSON output gains `findings`; local-rule and graph-rule findings print together; `--force` no longer hides them.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Issue creation output shows its findings, with no read after the mutation commits
